title.narrative: Weaving autonomy: Strengthening sexual and reproductive rights in the construction of peace and democracy for women and girls in PDET regions

description.narrative:
The project offers a comprehensive approach to sexual and reproductive health and rights in three regions of Colombia historically affected by the internal armed conflict, following the signing of the 2016 peace agreement.
The project seeks to strengthen the full exercise of sexual and reproductive rights of rural women (ex-combatants, ethnic, LGBTIQ+, migrants, and women from communities affected by armed conflict and sexual violence in Colombia) and the improvement of the environment for the exercise of and respect for women's sexual and reproductive autonomy.
The intervention includes access to sexual and reproductive health services (contraception and free and safe abortion), the strengthening of educational programmes on sexual and reproductive rights (comprehensive sexuality education), the political and civic empowerment of women to demand their sexual and reproductive rights (reproductive autonomy), and cultural change to prevent, address and redress sexual and reproductive violence and guarantee its non-repetition.
